# Medical and Lab Supplies

> > Medical and Lab Supplies provides laboratory equipment, sterile filtration systems, medical consumables, and organic carrier oils for research, healthcare, and compounding applications.

The site specializes in FDA-compliant and cGMP-certified laboratory supplies including borosilicate glass vials, Autofil filtration systems from Roush Life Sciences, BD medical devices, capsule filling equipment, and USDA certified organic oils for pharmaceutical and cosmetic formulation.

## Key Topics

- Sterile Filtration & Vacuum Filtration
- Type 1 Borosilicate Glass
- cGMP & FDA Compliance
- Autofil Bottle Top Filters
- BD Medical Devices
- USDA Certified Organic Oils
- Lyophilization & Freeze-Drying
- Capsule Filling & CRC Caps
- Laboratory Glassware (GL45)
- Roush Life Sciences Products
- Hemp Seed Oil & Cannabis Sativa
- Vitamin E & Vitamin A
- Cold-Pressed Carrier Oils
- Serum Vials & Amber Glass
- Quick-Connect Technology
